name: Meta AI
summary: Meta's AI assistant for questions, image generation and editing, available on the web and in Meta apps.
description: Meta AI is the assistant built by Meta and offered on meta.ai as well as inside Meta's apps. It answers questions in a chat interface, generates and edits images from text prompts, and helps with everyday tasks such as finding places or comparing products listed on Marketplace. Access is free with a Meta account.

howToUse.title: Open Meta AI
howToUse.description: Open Meta AI on meta.ai, or use the assistant inside Meta's apps. Access is free with a Meta account.

howToUse.title: Ask in the chat interface
howToUse.description: Ask questions in the chat interface and read what the assistant answers, including everyday tasks such as finding places.

howToUse.title: Generate or edit an image
howToUse.description: Enter a text prompt so Meta AI generates an image, or edit an image that is already in the conversation.

howToUse.title: Compare Marketplace products
howToUse.description: Ask it to help by comparing products listed on Marketplace when you are choosing between listings.
